🏭 Assembly Stations
Build each station's procedure step-by-step. Parts detected in procedure steps automatically appear in Poka-Yoke — assign sensor / camera / manual for each.
Builds stations from the process flow matching your Project Info Product Type — uses your current Process List if filled, otherwise the reference flow for that type.
🔀 Process Flow
Define the product's manufacturing process flow. Import a file (Excel/CSV) or add rows manually. Processes are auto-split into blocks by process category — then push them straight into Stations.
Load reference flow
Group by:
By product type = a full line; by process category = merged building blocks (duplicates combined). Adjust counts, side & CT to the actual part.

⚙ Equipment Plan
Auto-derives required equipment from your stations. Units per station = ⌈station cycle time ÷ design takt⌉. When a Product Type is selected on the Project Information page, unit prices default to that category's benchmark from the Price Reference library; otherwise rough placeholders are used. Edit the recommended equipment, unit count, and unit price as needed.

💲 Price Reference
Internal equipment price benchmark — K$ ranges by product category, plus the source project rows behind them. Reference only; figures are estimates.
🛠 Equipment Process Database
Pick a process, enter the quantity (weld points, clips, foam count, …) and the cycle time for each equipment type is computed from MINTH's standard equipment time models.
